selector.rationale: The presence of a homogeneous mass in the corpus callosum with rim enhancement and surrounding vasogenic edema on MRI, along with the patient's progressive neurological decline, supports the diagnosis of Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma.

rejected.label: Acute Disseminated Encephalomyelitis
rejected.why: Lack of clear evidence for demyelination and the presence of a distinct mass lesion

rejected.label: Cryptococcal meningitis
rejected.why: Negative CSF fungal cultures and lack of other supportive evidence

rejected.label: Glioblastoma
rejected.why: While imaging findings could be consistent, the clinical presentation and laboratory results do not strongly support this diagnosis over Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma

rejected.label: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy
rejected.why: Rejected as champion due to the presence of a mass lesion and the lack of definitive evidence for JC virus infection
